title: Traffic Routing / Shunt Rules
summary: Switches Passwall between ready-made traffic routing modes and records the active mode locally so the menu can show it later.

items.title: Iran Direct + Foreign Proxy (Recommended)
items.description: Iranian domains and IPs are reached directly while everything else goes through the proxy.
items.usage_tip: The most common setup for local users: fast local access, proxied foreign traffic.

items.title: Global Proxy (All traffic via proxy)
items.description: Routes all destinations through the proxy, including traffic inside the country.
items.usage_tip: Local sites become slower; use it mainly for testing or strict privacy needs.

items.title: Direct Only (Disable proxy)
items.description: Turns Passwall proxying off so every connection goes direct.
items.usage_tip: Handy for checking whether a problem comes from the proxy or the line.

items.title: Show current rules
items.description: Prints the saved routing mode and the rule file that belongs to it.
items.usage_tip: Read-only: nothing is changed on the router.

items.title: Back
items.description: Returns to the Proxy & Routing Manager.
items.usage_tip: The active routing mode stays applied.
